title: ARV Moment
description: A range on an asset. Identity is the canonical range after snapping. Chapters, shots and spans are all moments. end_ms stays on the moment for rights and receipts; players do not enforce it.

arv.description: ARV version. Every ARV object carries "arv": "1.0".

id.description: "mom_" + first 26 characters of lowercase base32 (RFC 4648, no padding) of SHA-256 over "{origin}|{asset_id}|{start_ms}|{end_ms}". Recomputable by anyone.

moment_uri.description: arv:{asset_id}#t={start_ms},{end_ms}. The canonical snapped range is the moment's identity.

moment_url.description: https deep link using Media Fragments in seconds (#t=12.4,31) or the player's own start parameter.

snap.description: The snap rule used. Omitted when the producer does not know it.

evidence.description: Typed spans, each fully inside [start_ms, end_ms].

evidence_grade.description: A human-verified; B machine-produced and passed the published automated check; C machine-produced with at least one direct span inside the range; D metadata or inference only.

aliases.description: Earlier ids for the same moment, for example a legacy amt_ id.
